verdict.rationale: No evidence of a public/platform API for programmatically creating or managing Bolt.new apps; the openapi/swagger probe returned 404 on all candidate paths, and all documented workflows describe UI-driven chat/prompt interactions, GitHub/Figma/Supabase integrations, not an API for external automation. Missing for 10: any documented REST/GraphQL API, SDK, or CLI for programmatic app generation and management.
